description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the LoginLogService in the OrangeHRM system. It verifies the functionality related to login log creation, including DAO retrieval and login log insertion for different login methods.

classes.name: LoginLogServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LoginLogService functionalities, including log retrieval, logging new login attempts, and OIDC login addition.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LoginService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetLoginLogDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getLoginLogDao() method returns an instance of LoginLogDao.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Tests the process of saving a login log entry including mocking dependencies like UserDao, UserService, Session, and DateTimeHelperService.

methods.name: testAddOIDCLogin
methods.description: Tests adding an OpenID Connect login log for a user, ensuring the log fields are correctly populated.
